boards.title: 观察方向
boards.prompt: Create an original educational visual reference contact sheet for a female character appearance atlas. Premium clean semi-realistic anime illustration, believable camera optics and coherent spatial geometry. One clearly adult woman aged around 28, shoulder-length chestnut bob hair, teal hip-length jacket over an opaque cream crew-neck shirt, straight charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Calm neutral expression, relaxed arms, no props unless required by composition. Modest ordinary clothing. Consistent identity and outfit throughout this sheet. No written text, codes, captions, logos or watermarks. Portrait canvas, exact uniform grid, straight thin dark dividing lines, no uneven gutters, no image spills across panel edges. Each panel must show the requested camera demonstration distinctly. Exactly TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, eight independent panels in row-major reading order. All panels are eye-level FULL BODY head-to-shoes, generous margin, woman standing upright in the same orientation relative to herself, neutral pale studio floor. Camera orbits her; she does NOT turn her face toward the camera except the frontal panel. 1 FRONT view, face and torso exactly straight toward camera. 2 LEFT FRONT three-quarter view, see front and left side. 3 RIGHT FRONT three-quarter view, mirrored direction of panel 2. 4 EXACT LEFT SIDE profile, face nose points LEFT on image, hips and feet side-on. 5 EXACT RIGHT SIDE profile, nose points RIGHT on image. 6 REAR LEFT three-quarter view, mostly back and left side, do not show full face. 7 REAR RIGHT three-quarter view, mostly back and right side. 8 EXACT REAR view, back of head, jacket and legs, no face. Every figure occupies roughly 80 percent of its own panel height. This is an atlas of WHOLE-BODY observation directions, not a fashion variation sheet.

boards.title: 机位高度与俯仰
boards.prompt: Create an original educational visual reference contact sheet for a female character appearance atlas. Premium clean semi-realistic anime illustration, believable camera optics and coherent spatial geometry. One clearly adult woman aged around 28, shoulder-length chestnut bob hair, teal hip-length jacket over an opaque cream crew-neck shirt, straight charcoal trousers and white sneakers. Calm neutral expression, relaxed arms, no props unless required by composition. Modest ordinary clothing. Consistent identity and outfit throughout this sheet. No written text, codes, captions, logos or watermarks. Portrait canvas, exact uniform grid, straight thin dark dividing lines, no uneven gutters, no image spills across panel edges. Each panel must show the requested camera demonstration distinctly. Exactly TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, six independent panels in row-major order. Same woman standing with head upright and looking horizontally forward, in a spacious tiled courtyard with subtle vertical architecture to make camera elevation readable. Frame the whole figure including shoes whenever physically visible; perspective foreshortening is the point. Do NOT simulate a high camera by merely making her bow her head. 1 EYE-LEVEL camera at her eye height, horizontal view, neutral perspective. 2 MODERATE HIGH CAMERA looking down at about 25 degrees, visible top of head and shoulders, receding floor. 3 STEEP HIGH CAMERA looking down about 60 degrees, crown prominent, torso and legs foreshortened. 4 TRUE VERTICAL OVERHEAD bird's-eye shot straight down, crown and shoulders seen from above, tiled floor fills frame. 5 MODERATE LOW CAMERA looking up about 20 degrees, visible underside of chin, architecture rises behind. 6 GROUND-LEVEL WORM'S-EYE upward shot from near her shoes, shoes and trouser legs nearer and larger, shoulders and head recede, visible sky and upward converging architecture. Trousers remain opaque and fully cover her legs in all views. These are distinct CAMERA HEIGHTS, not head gestures.

boards.title: 景别与取景范围
boards.prompt: Original visual-reference contact sheet for a female character appearance atlas. Clean premium semi-realistic anime illustration, believable camera optics and coherent spatial geometry. Same clearly adult woman about 28 in every panel, chestnut bob hair, teal jacket, opaque cream crew-neck shirt, straight charcoal trousers, white sneakers. Pale stone courtyard with trees and simple architecture. Consistent subject identity, clothing and lighting unless a panel specifically demonstrates another lighting environment. No sexualization.
